answer: Halvard Optics has shown the Meridian X9 headset but has not announced a release date.

results.title: Halvard Optics teases the Meridian X9 headset
results.content: Halvard Optics showed the Meridian X9 headset to a small group of reviewers. A spokesperson said the company has not set a release date and will share one when production starts.

results.title: Meridian X9: what we know so far
results.content: The Meridian X9 is Halvard Optics' first headset. Price, release date and regions are all still unannounced.
